target_anomaly: intermittent lock wait timeout on daily DELETE from EVENT_DETAILS
dba_description: Reproduce the MySQL/Aurora pattern where a daily DELETE on EVENT_DETAILS times out waiting for a row lock, while other sessions show long-lived open transactions and undo log growth on a table that has no PRIMARY KEY.
target_path: long-lived open transaction holding a row lock
daily DELETE scanning the date-leading secondary index
lock wait on the hidden clustered index
